statement: A way of Summoning a monster that its text lets its player choose, "(If ...,) you can Special Summon this card (from your hand)" (by a cost or not) or "(If ...,) you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing", is an effect of the card, classed as none of Ignition, Trigger, Quick or Continuous: an unclassified effect (SummonMethod kind UNCLASSIFIED). It makes no chain link, and negating the card's effects stops it. "You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing ..." isn't one: it is no effect (kind CONDITION; summoning-and-equip-conditions-are-not-effects).

sources.name: The Tricky
sources.says: Its Special Summon from the hand by discarding 1 card is an effect classed as none of Ignition, Trigger, Quick or Continuous (起動効果・誘発効果・誘発即時効果・永続効果のいずれにも分類されない効果です), and makes no chain link. Of the FAQs of cards whose English text says "you can Special Summon this card (from your ...)" and that class it, 130 say the same and none says it is no effect; of those that say "you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing", 42 say the same and none says it is no effect. Konami's Japanese texts that number their effects number every such procedure (296 Special Summons, 56 Normal Summons without Tributing) and none of the 24 Tribute Summons by other Tributes (read by Claude, 2026-11-21, from db-ygoresources-com/yugioh-faq-history and yugioh-card-history).

sources.name: Power Invader
sources.says: Its Normal Summon without Tributing is an unclassified effect, makes no chain link, and can't be a Set (セットする事はできません).

sources.name: Elfnote Lucina
sources.says: ① (its Special Summon from the hand to the center Main Monster Zone) is an unclassified effect, which makes no chain link; if a Special Summon this way is negated, it can be Special Summoned this way again that turn.

scripts: The scripts agree: these procedures (EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC, EFFECT_SUMMON_PROC) have EFFECT_FLAG_UNCOPYABLE only, so negating the card's effects stops them (Cyber Dragon c70095154, The Tricky c14778250, Power Invader c18842395, Elfnote Lucina c13597785), where a Tribute Summon procedure (Clown Crew Biancaviso c82159583, Granmarg the Mega Monarch c15545291) and a Summoning condition's (Chaos Sorcerer c9596126) have CANNOT_DISABLE too. Pyrotech Mech - Shiryu's "Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 monster" is the one disagreement found: its FAQ (card 10400, 2019) calls it unclassified and its script has neither flag, where every other Tribute Summon procedure is no effect; its Japanese text is old and says "Summon" (召喚できる), not "Tribute Summon" (アドバンス召喚できる), so it is for a person to decide.
